 WTA Ningbo Quarterfinal Best Bets Including Iva Jovic vs Diana Shnaider 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The WTA Ningbo Open continues the women’s tennis tour’s fall run in China. Running alongside WTA Osaka, Ningbo hasn’t seen the number of top-seed upsets we’ve seen in the last couple of tournaments. Of the top eight seeds, only No. 2 and No. 7 didn’t make it to the round of 16, and only one of them actually lost. The Nos. 8, 5, and 3 seeds lost during the round of 16. Iga Swiatek was the No. 2 seed, and she withdrew. Elise Mertens was the No. 7 seed, and she was upset by Leylah Fernandez in the first round. Swiatek sitting this one out could come back to hurt her in the World rankings, but that’s a conversation for a different day. The players left in the round of 16 will be hungry for those late-season points and success in this WTA Ningbo tournament. LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments. 
 WTA Ningbo 
 Bejlek – Bouzkova: 00:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 In this WTA Ningbo match, Sara Bejlek comes into the quarterfinals with momentum after beating Sorana-Mihaela Cirstea, a solid win. Marie Bouzkova’s previous match win in Ningbo came against Anastasia Zakharova, a much lower-ranked player than Cirstea. Both players are 3-2 in their last five matches, but Bejlek has 23 hardcourt wins this year compared to 16 for Bouzkova. Yet, Bouzkova is priced by the markets as a clear favorite. Are the markets right?  
 Best Bet to Make 
 Our WTA Ningbo betting angle is to favor Bejlek against the game spread. She doesn’t seem to be getting enough credit for the win over Cirstea. She might lose the match, but she will definitely keep it close. We also wouldn’t be shocked if Bejlek won, either. She’s definitely been turning heads lately.  
 That being said, betting on Bejlek +3.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Bejlek +3.5 games @1.77 @Betfair 
 Fernandez – Alexandrova: 2:00 EST 
 H2H: 2-3 
 This WTA Ningbo match is a really interesting one. Leylah Fernandez trails the head-to-head matchup against Ekaterina Alexandrova, but she won the last meeting, and that was in Wuhan, not very long ago. Fernandez won in three sets. Alexandrova is actually the betting market favorite here even though she just did lose to Fernandez. Let’s see if the markets get this one correct. 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Ningbo match could easily go three sets, so over 2.5 sets is a bet that should be considered. The last three matches between these players went three sets. However, we’re going with Fernandez against the game spread because she could easily be favored and yet is being priced as a 2.22 underdog while Alexandrova is 1.74 to win. Fernandez plus 3 games offers a reasonable return, and we’ll go for it.  
 That being said, betting on Fernandez +3 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Fernandez +3 games @1.62 @1xBet

Mandatory Credit: Geoff Bu… | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Jim Smith 
 Jovic – Shnaider: 4:00 EST 
 H2H: 1-0 
 This WTA Ningbo match is the best one of the four on Friday. Iva Jovic just beat Jasmine Paolini in straight sets. Diana Shnaider just beat Alexandra Eala in straight sets. Both players are in good form as they meet for a spot in the semifinals. Jovic is 3-2 in her last five matches. Shnaider is 4-1. 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Ningbo match leans toward Shnaider because she is beating better opponents than Jovic is. Shnaider’s recent 4-1 stretch of five matches includes wins over Eala and also Karolina Muchova. Jovic hasn’t beaten the same caliber of opponent. The match is priced close to a toss-up. Shnaider is the choice for our standalone wager. 
 That being said, betting on Shnaider winning is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Shnaider winning @1.95 @Unibet 
 Rybakina – Kawa: 7:00 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This WTA Ningbo match should not be too much of a problem for Elena Rybakina, the 2026 US Open champion. She faces Katarzyna Kawa, ranked No. 128 beginning the week and now 106 in the live rankings. The prices are what you would expect for a match between the World No. 1 and a player outside the top 100.  
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Ningbo match won’t give you a good moneyline or set spread price, since Rybakina is a huge favorite. The game spread is where to find value. Rybakina is such a big favorite that Kawa +7.5 games offers a good price. It’s hard to turn that down. Rybakina could win 6-3, 6-2 and still lose against the spread. Kawa just beat Belinda Bencic very easily and is probably good enough to win five games in this match. 
 That being said, betting on Kawa +7.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Kawa +7.5 games @1.83 @Bet365
